english_title: Recognising and Responding to Saying Thank You
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: greetings & basic social contact — saying thank you
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to saying thank you; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan thanks Ms Sophie for her advice.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan cảm ơn chị Sophie vì lời khuyên.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Sophie, thank you so much for the advice.
turns.vietnamese: Sophie này, cảm ơn chị rất nhiều vì lời khuyên.

turns.speaker: Ms Sophie
turns.english: That is very kind of you to say.
turns.vietnamese: Chị nói vậy tốt bụng quá.

turns.speaker: Ms Sophie
turns.english: I am glad to help anytime.
turns.vietnamese: Lúc nào tôi cũng vui khi giúp được chị.
